title: Contract-encoded stream validation and constrained-decode probes for tool-call safety
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build a focused test harness and probe-suite that validates strict JSON contract adherence across streamed token emits and interleaved tool/function calls. This ticket covers both deterministic unit probes and workload-style chaos probes to exercise constrained-decode backoffs, emit fencing, and canonical regeneration paths when schema violations occur during streaming responses or mid-tool-invocation. Goal: catch regressions that cause silent schema violations or unsafe tool-call payloads before deploy.
background_and_rationale: Recent canaries showed intermittent structured-output drift when models interleave long-tool call arguments and partial streaming emits. Existing suites verify final payloads but miss cases where a streamed token break leaves the decoder in a state that later produces a malformed tool-call body. This harness should simulate realistic network chunking, tokenizer boundary splits, and identical-model fallbacks to ensure runtime enforcers and constrained decoders handle partial emissions correctly.
acceptance_criteria: End-to-end test that reproduces a partial-stream induced schema violation and verifies automatic fallback to regeneration or safe empty-tool-call behavior
A set of constrained-decode probes that induce common failure modes: truncated arrays, missing required keys, stray commas, and mixed-type fields
Telemetry hooks that surface per-request failed-decoder-reasons and percent-of-streams-using-regeneration in console diagnostics
Automated gating: failure rate >0.1% on canary traffic blocks runtime-1.22 rollout
Documentation entry in the test-runbook describing how to triage a streaming contract regression and run the probe locally
tasks: Design probe scenarios and token-chunk permutations (Asha)
Implement harness that can feed token fragments and simulate delayed tool-call boundary (Liam)
Integrate constrained-decoder hooks and expose failure reasons to telemetry (backend: Noor)
Create canary job pipeline and dashboard panels (SRE: Miguel)
Author runbook and QA checklist for on-call (PM review: Marisol)
test_plan: Unit: deterministic decoders receive precomputed partial-emits and must either produce a validated JSON or a well-defined fallback token sequence
E2E: launch a local runtime with stream gateway, run 10K simulated requests with randomized chunk boundaries and assert 99.95% contract pass rate
Chaos: inject single-token loss in-stream at random positions while tool-call payloads are being constructed; assert no unsafe tool invocations reach external services
Compatibility: run against two model families (openllama-variants and community-ggml builds) to ensure decoder adaptation is model-agnostic
Regression: add test to CI that reproduces the highest-incident pattern observed in production canary logs
observability_requirements: New telemetry dimension: decoder_failure_reason tagged by failure_type, model_family, request_route
Alert: production error-rate spike for streaming contract failures (>0.1% over 1h)
Trace example links in dashboard to raw token stream and reconstructed JSON payload
runbook_steps: If alert fires, open the last 50 traces via the streaming-contract dashboard
Check decoder_failure_reason and compare against known patterns in this ticket
If pattern == 'partial-array-truncation', enable emergency canary fallback to contract-relax policy
Create a hotfix branch with the constrained-decoder patch and run canary suite locally before promoting
Notify PM and SRE on Slack channel #runtime-incident and attach reproduction steps
